summary.question: The customer on service svc266 (10GE between S18 and S24) reports a loss of service from about t=540 s. What is the cause?

llm.report: The system concluded that the service loss was caused by two fibre cuts: one on OMS S17–S18 span 3 and one on OMS S18–S24 span 0. Confidence is 99.6%. No additional checks, engineering effort, or site visits were recorded.

template: Cause: FIBRE_CUT@el:oms.S17-S18.span3()+FIBRE_CUT@el:oms.S18-S24.span0() (probability 0.996). Checks made: none. Effort: 0.0 h of tests and travel, 0 site visit(s).
